Remove PDP prior U04 phase-voltage mandatory unknown because term is not in raw notes; narrow CV prior U05 to generic signal state rather than support-only full/interlock terms. With CAU unknown split, total unknowns remain27. Support-only detail is optional, never a fixed required item.
Document unavailable HPU catalog dependency and forbidden extra lookup; distinguish explicit support relations, inferred relations, generic unit explanation and unobserved incident unit assignment.

Add task_prompt_path and actual_packet_utf8_bytes to execution-log fields; verify21 selected catalog refs using allowed projection and match map/card/coverage/version. Static check does not determine review/freeze status.
